## Change

Describe the finding, response, correction or audit-plan change.

## Report and finding identifiers

List the report paths and finding numbers. Link the relevant entry in ISSUES.md.

## Evidence and validation

Identify source commits or immutable artifacts, checks performed and any limits. For a project answer, include the project/responder, date and a `Corrected:` or `See:` reference.

## Record updates

Preserve existing finding numbers and attributed contributions. Update ISSUES.md when a finding's status changes. If reports change, regenerate the status table with `python3 bin/status.py`.
